dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are we... in the air? And why is there a huge boat!?

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: That's the Boat of Consciousness, which symbolizes reason here. Its course is the direction our consciousness is traveling towards.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: If we lose control over our consciousness, we will fall into madness... So let's make sure the boat stays on course.
